entries.topic: Status update after the Israeli election and the US midterms, 12 November 2026

claims.text: Associated Press (Colvin, Jalonick, Weissert), updated 4 November 2026: Democrats won control of both the House and the Senate in the 3 November 2026 midterms, 'a decisive rebuke of Republican governance in Washington'.

Israel election 27 October 2026; results 4 November; Netanyahu-aligned bloc 53, Eisenkot-led bloc 48, Arab-led parties 19; Herzog gave Eisenkot the mandate on 8 November; caretaker government in office.

sources.label: Associated Press via Atlanta Journal-Constitution, 4 Nov 2026: Democrats win US House, taking full control of Congress
